_comment: Combat tunables (core/combat). Seconds and tiles (1 tile = 2.5 ft). See docs/tracks/combat.md for why each number is what it is.

weapon_tempo._comment: One Attack action = wind-up, contact frame(s), recovery. total = windup + recovery. sweep: extra targets a melee arc may graze (see docs).

combo._comment: Extra Attack / Multiattack: the swings share one action's time. Follow-up contacts come gap apart (at most gap_max), taken out of the recovery, which keeps at least recovery_min.

tempo_move._comment: movement speed multiplier while a swing or a cast runs (1.0: no slowdown, as played in M2); cast_move tags (Steady) win back a share of the cast slowdown

tags._comment: caps on gear and spark tags combat reads

legendary._comment: Legendary Actions in real time (CombatSystem.legendary): at most one every gap_s seconds between the creature's own actions; uses as the stat block gives them, back at the start of its round

dodge._comment: The dodge roll (core/combat/dodge.gd). distance_tiles over duration_s from a standstill; keep_run_speed: from a run it keeps the run's speed. cooldown_s counts from the start of a roll. For hurt_from_s..hurt_to_s the hurt box is the tuck: hurt_width_mult and hurt_height_mult of the body's box, at its feet. A melee blow passes over a tuck whose top is blow_clearance_tiles under the height it was aimed at, unless the attacker is too_big_tiles tall or more. host_slack_s: how early the host lets the next roll or a swing after a roll arrive (packets bunch up).

feel._comment: How swings and blows read (view only, nothing here touches a roll or a tick). hit_stop_s, crit_stop_s: how long the own landed blow holds the attacker's and the victim's animation (0 disables). flash_s, crit_flash_s: the white flash on a struck body. flinch_s: the hit clip laid over its movement. fade_in_s, fade_out_s: how a swing clip joins and leaves the movement under it. combo_reset_s: after this long without a swing the next one opens the tempo's chain again. moving_speed: tiles a second from which the legs keep running through a swing. aim_arc_alpha: the faint arc of the next swing while a foe is near; aim_arc_tiles: how near. slash_s: one sweep across the arc; slash_lead_s: it starts this long before the contact. slash_width: the crescent's share of the reach, by tempo class. impact_tiles, impact_s: size and life of the mark a contact leaves. rim_m: width of a creature's outline. windup_rim_from, windup_rim_min: the share of a monster's wind-up after which its outline starts to burn, and how strong it stands before that. number_size: floating text by kind; crit_label_rise: tiles the Crit! stands over the number. roll_fade_s: the roll clip's fade in and out. colors: slash own, slash_foe, hit, crit, miss, target (in reach), near (under the aim, out of reach), windup.

cover._comment: fraction of the 3x3 sample rays blocked: 3 of 9 = half, 6 of 9 = three-quarters, all = total

durations_s._comment: A spell's duration text -> real seconds. Exact rows first, then n x per_unit (capped at a game day).

fall._comment: net drop from the last footing; dice = floor(ft / ft_per_die) once over free_ft; the roll times damage_mult, rounded down

lava._comment: a body touching a lava tile (TileDefs.burn) takes dice d sides of this damage type at once, then every every_s seconds while it stays (2: a round, K.ROUND_SECONDS)

light._comment: every player carries a torch until the items track has light sources

aim._comment: players' bodies are led by vel x (one-way delay + half a tick), the delay read from the client clock in each intent
